rounds.prompt:

Keep everything else pixel-identical to image 1: camera angle, lens, framing, helmet position and scale, background gradient, lighting direction and softness, shadows, reflections. The new helmet: matte olive-khaki dual-sport adventure helmet with a peak above a clear visor, visor closed. Matte shell, no logos, no text, no stickers, no graphics. Photorealistic studio photo, vertical 9:16, 1536x2752.
